licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. Rodolfo's printed alternative (the optional high C on 'speranza', bars 65-66) is not shown. Tempo from the printed metronome marks; where none is printed, a value chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
